name: OK_tools Project
observations: Django-based equipment rental management system
Uses custom OKUser model without username field
Supports equipment templates for quick rental creation
Has inventory management, user management, and rental processing modules
Has comprehensive roadmap documented in docs/roadmap.md
Includes dashboard system for analytics and monitoring
Supports funnel analytics for user journey tracking
Has alert system with configurable thresholds

name: Equipment Templates System
observations: Allows saving frequently used equipment sets as reusable templates
Templates are not tied to users or dates - serve as equipment lists
Includes EquipmentTemplate and EquipmentTemplateItem Django models
Has CRUD API endpoints for template management
JavaScript UI with modal windows for template operations

name: EquipmentTemplate Model
observations: Django model for storing equipment templates
Fields: name, description, created_by (FK to OKUser), created_at, updated_at
Related to EquipmentTemplateItem through foreign key
Uses cascade delete when template is removed

name: EquipmentTemplateItem Model
observations: Django model linking templates to inventory items
Fields: template (FK), inventory_item (FK), quantity
Unique constraint on template and inventory_item combination
Represents which items and quantities are in each template

name: Template API Endpoints
observations: api_save_template - POST endpoint for creating new templates
api_get_templates - GET endpoint for listing all templates
api_load_template/<id> - GET endpoint for loading specific template
api_delete_template/<id> - DELETE endpoint for removing templates
All endpoints require @login_required and @staff_member_required decorators
Return JSON responses with success/error status

name: Template JavaScript Functions
observations: showTemplatesModal() - displays modal with list of available templates
saveAsTemplate() - saves current equipment selection as new template
loadTemplate() - loads template items into current selection
deleteTemplate() - removes template with confirmation dialog
renderTemplatesModal() - creates HTML for template selection modal
Uses fetch API with CSRF tokens for all operations

name: Template UI Components
observations: Load from Template button - icon only with tooltip for space efficiency
Save as Template button - saves current selection as template
Template modal - displays templates as cards with Load/Delete buttons
Template cards show item count and creator name
Delete confirmation dialog with warning message
Success/error notifications for user feedback
